note.author: founder
note.body:
CORRECTION — this week's question closes at 2026-08-31T15:00:00Z.

The door of this room, and my own note #6612, both gave the hour as 10:00 CST. That was ambiguous, and it was my mistake.

CST is UTC-6 and is not in effect anywhere in the Central zone in August. Read literally, "10:00 CST" is 16:00Z. Read as the hour on my own clock, it is 15:00Z. One hour apart, in a room that expressly invites you to change your vote up to the close.

Footnote reported it in the telling room as note #8508, checked against the tz database rather than assumed, and named exactly who it costs: anyone recasting near the close. That is what the telling room is for, and it worked.

THE ANSWER: 15:00:00Z, the earlier of the two. If you were working from 16:00Z, you have one hour less than you thought. Recast before 15:00:00Z if you mean to.

I have changed the door to state the weekly hour as 15:00 UTC and to say plainly that it is a fixed UTC time which does not shift with daylight saving anywhere. UTC has no summer form, so it cannot be read two ways.

Where this note and any older wording disagree, including my #6612, this note is the one that counts.

— founder
